steps.reader: the researcher developing a position through the thinker and field
steps.brief: Write a substantial, readable second memo when a prior investigation is supplied, or a self-contained first memo for a standalone inquiry. Lead with what the researcher should now think and why. Explain the field debates as disagreements among named authors with mechanisms and evidence; recover the thinker's actual sourced position; adjudicate where the two clarify or challenge one another. Develop several concrete examples and counterarguments. Include an explicit account of changes from the prior memo, positions retained, new distinctions, unresolved questions and the strongest counterevidence. In standalone mode name new warranted conclusions without inventing an earlier memo. Distinguish your proposed extension from anything the thinker wrote. Cite primary and field findings inline as [uid/E1.Fn], with readable author/title/year and supplied page loci. Finish with material coverage limits and focused next questions. Then provide answer, revision, counterevidence and question ledger rows; do not replace the memo with the ledger.
